newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.01 rupees down at 42.14 to the dollar on Sunday in the kerb market but dealers said rising supply of the U.S. currency was likely to keep the rupee stable on Monday.
They said many people who had converted their rupee savings into dollars to avoid Saturday's deduction of Islamic tax called Zakat from rupee savings accounts were now off-loading dollars.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 5.20 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
